Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials redirects to Dashboard
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is reachable at the QA URL.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login page loads displaying the OrangeHRM logo, Username field, Password field, Login button, and 'Forgot your password?' link | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin'; no validation error appears | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters; no validation error appears | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The user is authenticated and redirected to the Dashboard page within 3 seconds; the sidebar and Dashboard heading are displayed
Expected Result: The user is authenticated, a valid session is created, and the Dashboard page is displayed.

Title: Verify login fails with valid username and incorrect password
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is reachable.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'wrongPass999' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page; no redirect to Dashboard occurs
Expected Result: The system displays 'Invalid credentials' and the user is not authenticated.

Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'NoSuchUser' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'NoSuchUser' | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page
Expected Result: The system displays 'Invalid credentials' and does not authenticate the user.

Title: Verify 'Required' validation on both fields when Login clicked with empty form
Precondition: The login page is loaded with both Username and Password fields empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed with empty Username and Password fields | 2. Leave both the Username and Password fields blank → Expected: Both fields remain empty | 3. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed beneath both the Username and Password fields; no redirect occurs and no authentication request proceeds
Expected Result: The system displays 'Required' for both fields and does not attempt authentication.

Title: Verify 'Required' validation when Username is blank and Password is entered
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Leave the Username field blank → Expected: The Username field is empty | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed beneath the Username field only; authentication does not proceed
Expected Result: The system displays 'Required' under the Username field and does not authenticate.

Title: Verify 'Required' validation when Password is blank and Username is entered
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Leave the Password field blank → Expected: The Password field is empty | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' validation message is displayed beneath the Password field only; authentication does not proceed
Expected Result: The system displays 'Required' under the Password field and does not authenticate.

Title: Verify whitespace-only username is trimmed and treated as blank triggering 'Required'
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter three space characters into the Username field → Expected: The Username field visually contains spaces | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The username is trimmed to empty, a 'Required' validation message is displayed for the Username field, and authentication does not proceed
Expected Result: The whitespace-only username is treated as blank and 'Required' is displayed.

Title: Verify leading and trailing spaces in username are trimmed before authentication
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is reachable.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter '  Admin  ' (with two leading and two trailing spaces) into the Username field → Expected: The Username field contains the padded value | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The username is trimmed to 'Admin', the user is authenticated, and the Dashboard is displayed
Expected Result: The trimmed username authenticates successfully and the Dashboard loads.

Title: Verify password with leading and trailing spaces is NOT trimmed and authenticates as entered
Precondition: A registered user account exists whose password is exactly ' spacePass ' (a leading and trailing space around 'spacePass'). The login page is reachable.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'SpaceUser' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'SpaceUser' | 3. Enter ' spacePass ' (with leading and trailing space) into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters for the full string including spaces | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The password is submitted without trimming, the user is authenticated, and the Dashboard is displayed
Expected Result: The password is transmitted un-trimmed and authentication succeeds.

Title: Verify username at maximum length boundary of 100 characters is accepted without silent truncation
Precondition: The login page is loaded. No account matches the long test string, so an 'Invalid credentials' outcome is acceptable provided no truncation-then-auth occurs.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter a 100-character string of 'a' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field accepts and displays the full 100 characters with no truncation | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The value is processed at its full 100-character length; because no such account exists, 'Invalid credentials' is displayed and no silent truncation followed by authentication occurs
Expected Result: The 100-character username is handled at full length without silent truncation.

Title: Verify pressing Enter with valid credentials triggers login equivalent to clicking Login
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is reachable.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field with focus remaining in that field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Press the Enter key → Expected: The login process is triggered, the user is authenticated, and the Dashboard is displayed within 3 seconds
Expected Result: Pressing Enter button the form and authenticates the user, matching the Login button behaviour.

Title: Verify Enter key does not trigger login when focus is on the Forgot Password link
Precondition: The login page is loaded with valid values in both fields but keyboard focus moved to the 'Forgot your password?' link.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field and 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: Both fields contain the entered values | 3. Move keyboard focus to the 'Forgot your password?' link using Tab → Expected: The link receives focus and shows a focus indicator | 4. Press the Enter key → Expected: The 'Forgot your password?' link is activated and the Password Reset page opens; the login form is not submitted and no Dashboard redirect occurs
Expected Result: Enter activates the focused link rather than submitting login.

Title: Verify 'Forgot your password?' link navigates to the Password Reset page
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: The login form and the 'Forgot your password?' link are displayed | 2. Click the 'Forgot your password?' link → Expected: The application navigates to the Password Reset page displaying the reset form (e.g., a Username field and a Reset Password button)
Expected Result: The user is redirected to the Password Reset page.

Title: Verify direct deep-link to a protected page without a session redirects to Login
Precondition: No authenticated session exists (user is logged out and cookies cleared).
Steps: 1. Ensure no active session exists by clearing cookies for the application domain → Expected: No session cookie is present | 2. Navigate directly to the protected Dashboard URL https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/dashboard/index → Expected: The application redirects to the login page instead of rendering the Dashboard
Expected Result: Unauthenticated access to a protected page is blocked and redirected to Login.

Title: Verify Logout terminates the session and browser Back does not restore the Dashboard
Precondition: A registered user is logged in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' and is viewing the Dashboard.
Steps: 1. Log in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' → Expected: The Dashboard is displayed | 2. Open the user dropdown menu in the top-right and click 'Logout' → Expected: The session is terminated and the user is redirected to the login page | 3. Press the browser Back button → Expected: The Dashboard is not restored from cache; the user remains on or is redirected to the login page and cannot access protected content
Expected Result: Logout ends the session and the Dashboard cannot be reached via the Back button.
